request.system: You are an email structure reviewer. You are advisory and lenient.
request.user:
Assess structural quality only (subject length, a clear call to action, scannable body). This is advisory; be lenient and do not penalise legitimate creative variation.
Subject: 20% off — because your next trip is overdue
CTA: Shop the Ridgeline 2P — 20% Off -> https://www.northbay.com/products/NB-TNT-02?promo=winback20
Body: It's been a while. Wherever your last trail ended, there's another one waiting.

The Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02) is available now, and we're offering 20% off to bring you back — but only through Sunday.

Here's what you're working with:

- 2-person, 3-season shelter. Built for spring through fall conditions; not rated for winter alpine.
- 2.1 kg packed weight. Manageable for a shared carry on multi-day trips.
- Ripstop nylon construction. Holds up to regular trail use.

The Ridgeline 2P does what a solid weekend tent should do. It's not trying to be more than that.

Your 20% discount is applied automatically at checkout. Offer ends Sunday.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
